scope: Current factual acquisition, page-unlock, teleport, recharge, upgrade, and replacement rules for Kharedst's memoirs and Book of the dead. This record deliberately excludes route ordering, utility scoring, and account-specific recommendations.

records.name: Kharedst's memoirs and Book of the dead Kourend teleports
records.factual_boundary: All requirements below are current requirements. Historical Kourend favour and Architectural Alliance requirements are intentionally excluded because Kourend favour was removed on 10 January 2024.

required_item.consumed_or_transformed: The feather is used with Veos's enchanted scroll to make the enchanted quill.

base_item_acquisition.initial_transport_state: The unpaged memoirs have no usable city teleport. At least one ordinary memoir page must be added before Old Memorial recharge dialogue is available.

current_quest_gates.quest_prerequisite: Client of Kourend (and therefore X Marks the Spot)

ordinary_memoir_pages.unlocked_teleport_destination: Hosidius, by the River Hos near the lancallium patch; this is north-east of the Forthos Ruin/Dungeon entrances.

current_quest_gates.quest_prerequisite: Client of Kourend (and therefore X Marks the Spot)
current_quest_gates.required_quest_item: Stew is given to Robert O'Reilly during the quest.

current_quest_gates.quest_prerequisite: Client of Kourend (and therefore X Marks the Spot)
required_items: runes for 2-3 casts of any Magic combat spell
melee weapon of any kind (a pickaxe is sufficient)

ordinary_memoir_pages.unlocked_teleport_destination: Graveyard of Heroes, south-west of the Shayzien bank.

current_quest_gates.quest_prerequisite: Client of Kourend (and therefore X Marks the Spot)
current_quest_gates.required_item: Tinderbox; one is obtainable during the quest.

ordinary_memoir_pages.unlocked_teleport_destination: North-east of the bank in Lovakengj.

current_quest_gates.quest_prerequisite: Client of Kourend (and therefore X Marks the Spot)

page_and_teleport_rules.application: Use a quest-earned torn page on the memoirs to unlock its corresponding Reminisce teleport.
page_and_teleport_rules.wilderness_restriction: Neither item can teleport the player beyond level 20 Wilderness.

recharging.location: Old Memorial, north of Land's End on Great Kourend.
recharging.access_condition: The memoirs or Book of the dead must contain at least one ordinary teleport page; the secret page alone does not enable the recharge dialogue.
recharging.free_recharge_alternative: None listed; every manual charge adds the stated Magic experience.

book_of_the_dead_upgrade.result: Kharedst's memoirs is upgraded to Book of the dead. It retains the five possible Kourend teleport destinations and additionally serves as the required equipped-or-inventory item for resurrection spells.
book_of_the_dead_upgrade.inherited_quest_chain: Each listed quest requires Client of Kourend, which requires X Marks the Spot.

required_inputs.spellbook_and_spell: Normal spellbook and runes to cast a fire spell of Fire Bolt or higher.
one_of: pickaxe and chisel to obtain a dark essence block at the mine

mandatory_combat: Judge of Yama (level 168; can only be damaged with Melee)

current_charge_change.explanation: The five prerequisite page quests already give the fully completed memoirs 100 charges; the current 2024 change supplies 150 additional charges when Book of the dead is obtained, for 250 total.

before_A_Kingdom_Divided_completion.memoirs_reclaim: Speak to Veos on the Port Piscarilius docks. After partial completion of A Kingdom Divided, Cabin Boy Herbert there can also reclaim it.
before_A_Kingdom_Divided_completion.charge_retention_on_destroy: Any stored charges are retained when the memoirs are destroyed.
before_A_Kingdom_Divided_completion.unapplied_torn_pages: A page lost before it is added can be reclaimed from the lord of its respective Kourend house.

after_A_Kingdom_Divided_completion.free_reclaim: Commander Fullore on the ground floor of Kourend Castle.

optional_non_transport_secret_page.acquisition: Use a knife on Kharedst's memoirs.
optional_non_transport_secret_page.replacement: Use a knife on the memoirs again if the secret page is lost before it is added.

records.confidence: high for item mechanics, costs, capacities, current quest/skill gates, and replacements; destinations are stated at the source's level of geographic precision.
